wire.errors.desktop.attachment_fetch_pen.role: API refusal text shown where a remote conversation's file would render (image tile, audio player, document preview)
wire.errors.desktop.attachment_fetch_pen.tone: plain, calm, tells the user what happens next
wire.errors.desktop.attachment_fetch_pen.width: one or two sentences; shown inline in a tile or in a toast
wire.errors.desktop.attachment_fetch_pen.note: 504 with Retry-After, retryable: a large file from another device is still transferring when the request's wait ends; the transfer continues and the next request joins it, so the sentence asks the user to try again. {device} is the other device's name.

wire.errors.desktop.attachment_owner_ref.role: API refusal text shown where a remote conversation's file would render (image tile, audio player, document preview)
wire.errors.desktop.attachment_owner_ref.width: one or two sentences; shown inline in a tile or in a toast
wire.errors.desktop.attachment_owner_ref.note: 409, permanent: the device that holds the conversation refused to send this file. {reason} is a machine code selecting the clause and is never shown: not_referenced (the conversation no longer refers to the file), missing (gone from that device), not_allowed (this device's access to the conversation was revoked), integrity (the bytes did not match), other. {device} is the other device's name.

wire.errors.desktop.attachment_owner_unr.role: API refusal text shown where a remote conversation's file would render (image tile, audio player, document preview)
wire.errors.desktop.attachment_owner_unr.tone: plain, calm, tells the user what to do
wire.errors.desktop.attachment_owner_unr.width: one or two sentences; shown inline in a tile or in a toast
wire.errors.desktop.attachment_owner_unr.note: 504, retryable: the device that holds a remote conversation (or this device's relay) is not answering, so a picture, recording or document from it cannot be fetched. The desktop retries on its own and then offers a retry, so the sentence asks the user to try again rather than promising an automatic load. {device} is the other device's name; one mention.

wire.errors.desktop.attachment_peer_outd.role: API refusal text shown where a remote conversation's file would render (image tile, audio player, document preview)
wire.errors.desktop.attachment_peer_outd.tone: plain, calm, tells the user what happens next
wire.errors.desktop.attachment_peer_outd.width: one or two sentences; shown inline in a tile or in a toast
wire.errors.desktop.attachment_peer_outd.note: 409, permanent until the other device updates. The backticked `lop network update {peer}` is a command: keep it untranslated, in backticks, with {peer} (the device ID) inside. {device} is the other device's display name.

wire.errors.desktop.session_files_downlo.role: API refusal text for a file listed in a conversation held on another device (Files panel, download)
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_downlo.tone: plain, calm, says why and what to do
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_downlo.width: one or two sentences; inline in a row tooltip or a toast
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_downlo.note: 409: every collision-free name for a downloaded file is taken. {name} is the file name, {folder} the destination folder path.

wire.errors.desktop.session_files_downlo.role: API refusal text for a file listed in a conversation held on another device (Files panel, download)
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_downlo.tone: plain, calm, says why and what to do
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_downlo.width: one or two sentences; inline in a row tooltip or a toast
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_downlo.note: 409: integrity check of a downloaded remote file failed; nothing landed. {device} is the other device's name.

wire.errors.desktop.session_files_owner_.role: API refusal text shown in the Files panel of a conversation held on another device
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_owner_.tone: plain, calm, tells the user what to do
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_owner_.width: one or two sentences; shown in the panel body
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_owner_.note: 504, retryable: the Files panel of a conversation held on another device cannot be listed because that device (or this device's relay) is not answering. The panel offers a retry. {device} is the other device's name; one mention.

wire.errors.desktop.session_files_remote.role: API refusal text for a file listed in a conversation held on another device (Files panel, download)
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_remote.tone: plain, calm, says why and what to do
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_remote.width: one or two sentences; inline in a row tooltip or a toast
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_remote.note: 409, permanent: a file listed in a conversation held on another device cannot be read from here. {device} is the other device's name; {reason} is a machine code selecting the clause and is never shown. 'scratchpad' is the conversation's own shared folder (glossary term). Keep the 256 MiB figure. The 'sensitive' clause covers hidden files (a name starting with a dot) as well as credential-shaped names.

wire.errors.desktop.session_files_sensit.role: API refusal text for a file listed in a conversation held on another device (Files panel, download)
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_sensit.tone: plain, calm, says why and what to do
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_sensit.width: one or two sentences; inline in a row tooltip or a toast
wire.errors.desktop.session_files_sensit.note: 409: download of a remote file refused because its name matches the credential vocabulary (.env, id_rsa…). {name} is the file name.

wire.errors.desktop.session_in_project.note: Refuses making a project-linked conversation temporary. {session_id} is a 12-character id.

wire.errors.desktop.session_pinned.note: Refuses making a pinned conversation temporary. {session_id} is a 12-character id.

wire.errors.desktop.session_temporary.tone: plain, lower-case start like its neighbours
wire.errors.desktop.session_temporary.note: A 'temporary chat' is not kept: it is deleted after a period of inactivity. Pinning or linking it to a project is refused until the user chooses to keep the chat. {session_id} is a 12-character id.

wire.errors.desktop.session_temporary_de.note: Shown when someone opens a temporary chat that was already deleted automatically for inactivity. Not an error the user caused.

wire.errors.desktop.settings_intent_gene.role: API refusal text for cancelling or dismissing a queued settings change (model, effort, fast mode or working directory) in the desktop app
wire.errors.desktop.settings_intent_gene.tone: plain, calm, reassuring: nothing went wrong
wire.errors.desktop.settings_intent_gene.width: one sentence, shown in a toast or under the settings chip
wire.errors.desktop.settings_intent_gene.note: 409 generation_moved: the user picked again for the same setting after the change they tried to cancel, so the newer pick stands and there is nothing to cancel. 'change' means a requested settings change, not a code change. No placeholders.

wire.errors.desktop.skill_alias_occupied.role: API refusal text shown in the Skills tab
wire.errors.desktop.skill_alias_occupied.tone: plain, calm, tells the user the next step
wire.errors.desktop.skill_alias_occupied.width: two sentences; wraps inline or in a toast
wire.errors.desktop.skill_alias_occupied.note: 409 name collision. For Hub pulls, --dry-run previews adoption instead of moving/deleting the local folder; choosing another name remains valid. --dry-run is untranslated; no placeholders.

wire.errors.desktop.skill_local_changes_.role: API refusal text shown in the Skills tab
wire.errors.desktop.skill_local_changes_.tone: plain, calm, tells the user the next step
wire.errors.desktop.skill_local_changes_.width: two sentences, shown in a confirm dialog
wire.errors.desktop.skill_local_changes_.note: 409; removing a hub-linked skill whose local edits were never published; the remove removes only the local copy and the edits are not kept. 'Publish' = the Skills tab's Publish action; no placeholders

wire.errors.desktop.skill_not_editable.role: API refusal text shown in the Skills tab
wire.errors.desktop.skill_not_editable.tone: plain, calm, tells the user the next step
wire.errors.desktop.skill_not_editable.width: one sentence, shown inline under a skill editor or in a toast
wire.errors.desktop.skill_not_editable.note: 409; the skill lives in a read-only folder (built-in, another tool's, or a project's). 'Copy it to your skills' is the Skills tab's Copy action; no placeholders

wire.errors.desktop.skill_stale.role: API refusal text shown in the Skills tab
wire.errors.desktop.skill_stale.tone: plain, calm, tells the user the next step
wire.errors.desktop.skill_stale.width: one sentence, shown inline under a skill editor or in a toast
wire.errors.desktop.skill_stale.note: 409; the saved fingerprint no longer matches the folder (edited elsewhere); the editor reloads; no placeholders

wire.errors.desktop.temporary_mark_faile.note: The temporary flag could not be written; the conversation is kept as a normal one (or, on create, not created). {session_id} is a 12-character id.

wire.errors.desktop.temporary_not_user.note: Refuses making an agent-started conversation (a delegated run or an agent workstream) temporary. {session_id} is a 12-character id.

wire.errors.desktop.temporary_peer_unsup.note: Temporary chats are only available on this device for now.
